name: vision_onnx_service
title: Train, export to ONNX, serve behind FastAPI - one shared pre-processing definition, written correctly
origin: domain-vision round 1: the train/export/serve triple, the shape MLV901 (train-serve skew) exists for

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
serving_transform() is Resize + CenterCrop + ToTensor + Normalize, and it is what the validation dataset is built with
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward()
backward() precedes step()
the no_grad regions are evaluate() and export_onnx(), neither of which back-propagates
the running loss accumulates loss.item()
evaluate() calls model.eval() first and export_onnx() calls model.eval() before tracing
evaluate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
the ResNet head returns logits and the criterion is CrossEntropyLoss; the softmax lives in the service, applied once, to the exported logits
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the images and labels are moved to the model's device in both loops
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy and torch
the two splits are two directories
there is no nn.Module subclass here; the model is a torchvision backbone with a replaced head
no submodule list exists in this project
torch.save writes the state_dict(); nothing calls torch.load
